model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if BTC-USD on Coinbase trades at or above $85,000 at any point before Sep 15, 2026, 23:59 UTC.
- "No": Wins if BTC-USD on Coinbase does not reach $85,000 at any point before Sep 15, 2026, 23:59 UTC.

Clarifications:
- "Reach $85,000" means the spot price of BTC-USD on Coinbase touches or exceeds $85,000.00 USD at any moment during the observation window (up to and including Sep 15, 2026, 23:59 UTC), not only at the settlement time.
